Name: Coconut bra
Author: BlueGatorade07
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a coconut bra to the game. Now you can wear it to the beach, the desert, or Ginger Island. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Purchase from Sandy's Oasis for 450 gold, or craft with the sewing machine.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Tailoring recipes[/color]
[spoiler][color=#d4d4d8]Wool and coconut 
Seaweed and coconut[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#d4d4d8]No known compatibility issues[/color]

[size=4][b]Future plans [/b][/size]
None

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
1.5 (Optional) download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] 
2. Download the mod
3. Unzip into your mods folder
4. Run the game
